name: Private Label Candles
description: Private Label Candles (PLC) is a Central Florida manufacturer of private label and unlabeled candles and home-fragrance products. Businesses can sell PLC-made products under their own brand, customizing the scent, vessel, label design and packaging, either with guidance from PLC's team or through the online 3D Product Designer. PLC also sells unlabeled (blank) products ready for customers' own branding, professional-use fragrance products by the gallon, and offers a fragrance library of over 90 scents plus custom fragrance development.
industry: Private label candle and home fragrance manufacturing
services: Financing via CreditKey (Buy Now, Pay Over Time)
standard_lead_time: 6-8 weeks for full orders (per the FAQ); rush service can reduce this to 3-4 weeks
note: Compiled on 2026-11-17 from the public FAQ, Unlabeled Products and Fragrance Library pages of privatelabelcandles.com. Street address not listed on those pages.
